title: Schema registry product, hosting and subject naming are not specified
source: Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 11, 21, 22, 42 and 43 (JSON Schema registry, BACKWARD compatibility, AsyncAPI 3.0 per topic, schema subjects); Template and Rules v1 §R4
description: The architecture requires a JSON Schema registry with BACKWARD compatibility, an AsyncAPI 3.0 document per topic and schema subjects on the bank Kafka platform, and slide 21 lists the schema registry among the items still to confirm with the ACE platform team. No source names the registry product, its hosting, the subject naming convention, the registry API used by the build, or the compatibility check point. The story can define the compatibility rule and the build gate, not the product and the subject names.
evidence: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 11 call-type table (JSON Schema registry, backward compatible; AsyncAPI 3.0), slide 21 notes (schema subjects; to confirm: schema registry), slide 22 notes (JSON body validated against the registry, BACKWARD compatibility), slides 42 and 43 notes (schemas versioned in the registry with BACKWARD compatibility)
proposed: Select the registry together with the Kafka hosting decision (the bank platform registry, with the Event Hubs Premium registry as the fallback) and fix the subject naming in the Wave 0 Kafka Topic and Event Catalog

title: Retry and dead-letter topic names, ACL principals and quotas are not specified
source: Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 9, 11, 21, 22 and 35 (topic per service, 12 partitions, replication factor 3, 7-day retention, key caseId, retry 1 min, 10 min, 1 h then .dlt, per-service ACLs); Template and Rules v1 §R4
description: The architecture fixes the event topic pattern rwb.<short>.events.v1, 12 partitions, replication factor 3, 7-day retention, key caseId, the three retry windows and a dead-letter topic, and requires per-service ACLs. No source document gives the derived retry and dead-letter topic names, the ACL principal model and names, the quota values per service, or the environment list. The story can provision the event topics from the pattern but cannot create the retry, dead-letter and ACL artefacts from the documents alone.
evidence: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 9 notes (Kafka settings), slide 11 call-type table (retry topics 1 min / 10 min / 1 h, then .dlt + alert), slide 21 notes (to confirm with the ACE platform team: capacity, topic naming, ACL model, schema registry, environments), slide 22 notes (retry topics and dead-letter topic with an alert and a replay tool), slide 35 (Kafka ACLs per service)
proposed: Agree the retry and dead-letter naming, the ACL principal model and the quotas with the ACE platform team and record them in the Wave 0 Kafka Topic and Event Catalog before provisioning

title: Blob container names, Key Vault key names, rotation and MFT/SFTP endpoints are not specified
source: Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 8, 11, 16, 24, 31, 32 and 35 (Blob WORM for documents, codec keys in Key Vault, 15-minute SAS link, MFT/SFTP with PGP for WIN and debt buyers)
description: The architecture fixes Blob storage with WORM for documents (rwb-document only, 2.8 TB by 2031), the Temporal payload codec with AES-GCM keys in Key Vault per namespace, a SAS link for one file for 15 minutes with a manifest, and MFT/SFTP with PGP for the WIN file (INT-14) and the debt-buyer files (INT-25). No source gives the container names, the immutable retention period per container, the Key Vault name, the codec key names and rotation period, the MFT/SFTP endpoint names, the PGP key ownership, or the network ranges. The story can define the standard shape of the three resources, not their names and values.
evidence: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 8 (Blob WORM documents; Key Vault codec server), slide 11 call-type table (File: Blob + MFT/SFTP, PGP; SAS link, one file, 15 minutes; manifest fileId, batchId, sha256, record count), slide 16 (Azure Blob WORM, 2.8 TB by 2031), slide 24 (codec AES-GCM, Key Vault), slides 31 and 32 (WIN 16:00 INT-14, buyer files INT-25 over MFT or SFTP)
proposed: Fix the names, the immutable retention periods, the key rotation runbook and the MFT/SFTP endpoints in the Wave 0 standard resource list and in the network and security design
